#include <cstring>
#include <cctype>
#include <tuple>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;

const int MAX_NODES = 7100;
const int MAX_SIZE = 14;
const ll INF = 1000000000;

struct Edge {
    int src, dst;
    ll flow, capacity;
};

struct FlowNetwork {
    int source, sink;
    vector<Edge> edgeList;
    vector<int> adj[MAX_NODES];
    int level[MAX_NODES], indexPtr[MAX_NODES];
    
    void clearAll() {
        edgeList.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_NODES; ++i) adj[i].clear();
    }
    
    void addEdge(int u, int v, ll cap) {
        edgeList.push_back({u, v, 0, cap});
        edgeList.push_back({v, u, 0, 0});
        adj[u].push_back(edgeList.size() - 2);
        adj[v].push_back(edgeList.size() - 1);
    }
    
    bool computeLevels() {
        memset(level, -1, sizeof(level));
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(source);
        level[source] = 0;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            for (int id : adj[u]) {
                Edge& e = edgeList[id];
                if (level[e.dst] == -1 && e.capacity > e.flow) {
                    level[e.dst] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.push(e.dst);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[sink] != -1;
    }
    
    ll push(int u, ll flow) {
        if (u == sink || flow == 0) return flow;
        for (int& i = indexPtr[u]; i < (int)adj[u].size(); ++i) {
            int id = adj[u][i];
            Edge& e = edgeList[id];
            if (level[e.dst] == level[u] + 1 && e.capacity > e.flow) {
                ll pushed = push(e.dst, min(flow, e.capacity - e.flow));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.flow += pushed;
                    edgeList[id ^ 1].flow -= pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    
    ll getMaxFlow() {
        ll total = 0;
        while (computeLevels()) {
            memset(indexPtr, 0, sizeof(indexPtr));
            while (ll pushed = push(source, INF)) {
                total += pushed;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }
};

FlowNetwork network;
char initialGrid[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE], finalGrid[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
bool visitedCells[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
int timeDistance[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];
int gridSize, timeLimit;
int targetIndex[103];

int encode(int t, int x, int y) {
    return t * gridSize * gridSize + (x - 1) * gridSize + y;
}

void bfsFromStart(int sx, int sy) {
    queue<tuple<int, int, int>> q;
    for (int i = 0; i < MAX_SIZE; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < MAX_SIZE; ++j)
            timeDistance[i][j] = 111;
    
    timeDistance[sx][sy] = 0;
    q.emplace(sx, sy, 0);
    int dx[] = {1, 0, 0, -1}, dy[] = {0, 1, -1, 0};
    
    while (!q.empty()) {
        auto [x, y, d] = q.front(); q.pop();
        if (visitedCells[x][y]) continue;
        visitedCells[x][y] = true;
        timeDistance[x][y] = d;
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
            int nx = x + dx[i], ny = y + dy[i];
            if (nx < 1 || nx > gridSize || ny < 1 || ny > gridSize || visitedCells[nx][ny] || initialGrid[nx][ny] == 'Y')
                continue;
            q.emplace(nx, ny, d + 1);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    cin >> gridSize >> timeLimit;
    for (int i = 1; i <= gridSize; ++i) cin >> (initialGrid[i] + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= gridSize; ++i) cin >> (finalGrid[i] + 1);
    
    network.clearAll();
    network.source = 0;
    network.sink = MAX_NODES - 2;
    
    int startX = 0, startY = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= gridSize; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= gridSize; ++j) {
            if (initialGrid[i][j] == 'Z') {
                startX = i; startY = j;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= gridSize * gridSize; ++i)
        targetIndex[i] = MAX_NODES - 3 - (gridSize * gridSize - i);
    
    bfsFromStart(startX, startY);
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= gridSize; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= gridSize; ++j) {
            if (isdigit(initialGrid[i][j]))
                network.addEdge(network.source, encode(0, i, j), initialGrid[i][j] - '0');
            if (isdigit(finalGrid[i][j]))
                network.addEdge(targetIndex[encode(0, i, j)], network.sink, finalGrid[i][j] - '0');
            network.addEdge(encode(0, i, j), targetIndex[encode(0, i, j)], INF);
        }
    }
    
    int dx[] = {1, 0, 0, -1}, dy[] = {0, 1, -1, 0};
    for (int t = 1; t <= timeLimit; ++t) {
        for (int i = 1; i <= gridSize; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= gridSize; ++j) {
                if (initialGrid[i][j] == 'Y' || initialGrid[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                    int ni = i + dx[d], nj = j + dy[d];
                    if (ni >= 1 && ni <= gridSize && nj >= 1 && nj <= gridSize &&
                        initialGrid[ni][nj] != 'Y' && initialGrid[ni][nj] != 'Z' &&
                        timeDistance[i][j] >= t && timeDistance[ni][nj] >= t) {
                        network.addEdge(encode(t - 1, ni, nj), encode(t, i, j), INF);
                    }
                }
                network.addEdge(encode(t, i, j), targetIndex[encode(0, i, j)], INF);
            }
        }
    }
    
    cout << network.getMaxFlow() << '\n';
    return 0;
}
